g.aria-label: Title text 'D14, signed-MW six: injected lag-only event, +50% of capacity for 15 days (pass 1) Only the lag inputs carry the shift; the observed power (orange) is the normal running arrangement (black dashed, same line). Dark band: q05-q95. Light band: q01-q99. Grey shade: the injected shift in the lags. Coloured strips: origin days in event mode (C2's gate).'

text.font-family: Matter XH, DM Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: D14, signed-MW six: injected lag-only event, +50% of capacity for 15 days (pass 1)
Only the lag inputs carry the shift; the observed power (orange) is the normal running arrangement (black dashed, same line).
Dark band: q05-q95. Light band: q01-q99. Grey shade: the injected shift in the lags. Coloured strips: origin days in event mode (C2's gate).
